title: CLTR Cutover QuarantineRecord record
description: Phase 136V, Implementation Group 11 (CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.30, Sec.46). A QuarantineRecord document describes a claimed current-authority-integrity failure for a named object; it never itself moves, renames, deletes, releases, repairs, or blocks execution of an artifact, revokes authority, mutates lifecycle state, or triggers a notification/marker/receipt (Sec.1, Sec.30, Sec.40). Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative. Tier 2 (_extensions only, Sec.14). authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden (Sec.9's 12-file list includes quarantine_record) -- this is the structural guarantee that a quarantine record can never itself become the fallback authority by being schema-valid (Sec.30). Not in the phase_id-required or transition_id-required family lists (Sec.7.2), so neither field is declared here; migration_epoch remains required per Sec.7.2's universal rule. Sec.30's field table does not separately list the universal envelope fields; consistent with every other family's precedent (e.g. 136T's NON-BLOCKING-136T-2/136T-3/136T-5), this schema applies the uniform envelope + authority_disclosure + limitations pattern. Sec.30's 'digest' field is realized as the universal record_digest field (same restatement pattern). Sec.16's local conditional-validation table and CSCH-EXEC-REQ-041 both name the unconditionally-required reason field 'quarantine_reason', while Sec.30's own field table and Sec.30's own prose ('every quarantine record requires a non-null reason_code') both name it 'reason_code'; this schema resolves the discrepancy in favor of 'reason_code', per the field-table-literalism rule (Sec.30's field table is the most specific binding clause for this family, and it is internally corroborated by Sec.30's own prose using the identical name) -- disclosed as NON-BLOCKING-136V-5. This field is unconditionally required (Sec.16's own row label is 'quarantine_record (always)'), so it is enforced via the top-level 'required' list rather than an if/then. object_reference is typed as the generic shared/references.schema.json#/$defs/record_reference (Sec.30) with no per-object_type record_family restriction: Sec.30 defines no such conditional, and one branch (object_type 'generation') has no corresponding record_family enum member to restrict to in the first place (shared/enums.schema.json's record_family enum has no 'generation' entry -- 'generation' is a distinct, non-family concept per Sec.12's generation_reference shape), making a uniform conditional restriction structurally impossible to state for every branch; consistent with the established NON-BLOCKING-136R-3 precedent (no family restriction invented where the contract specifies none), this is disclosed as NON-BLOCKING-136V-6. Sec.16's own conditional-validation table lists no other within-document conditional for this family beyond the unconditional reason-code requirement; the operator-prompt's illustrative conditional examples (release evidence, expiry, retained-state field prohibitions) are not contract-defined anywhere in Sec.16 or Sec.30 and are therefore not implemented, consistent with the instruction not to invent unfrozen fields.

schema_id.description: Always present. Identifies this document as validated against the QuarantineRecord schema.

schema_version.description: Always present. This file's own MAJOR.MINOR version.

contract_version.description: Always present. CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 version this schema was generated against.

record_type.description: Always present. Fixed family tag for this record type.

record_id.description: Always present. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

record_digest.description: Always present. Digest of this document itself. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2. Restates Sec.30's 'digest' field.

created_at.description: Always present. Never used to establish record identity or ordering across documents.

migration_epoch.description: Always present. Every companion record binds to exactly one migration epoch (Sec.7.2, CSCH-INV-1). quarantine_record is not in the phase_id-required or transition_id-required family lists (Sec.7.2).

object_type.description: Always present (Sec.30). Which kind of object this quarantine record concerns. A schema-valid value never itself proves the referenced object actually exists or was actually quarantined for the claimed reason (Layer 4).

object_reference.description: Always present (Sec.30). Generic record_reference with no per-object_type record_family restriction (NON-BLOCKING-136V-6): object_type's 'generation' value has no corresponding record_family enum member, making a uniform conditional restriction structurally impossible; the other three object_type values (publication_attempt, authority_state, compatibility_state) do correspond to record_family members but Sec.30 defines no conditional tying them together, so none is invented here. A valid reference never implies the referenced object actually exists or matches the claimed object_type (Layer 4).

reason_code.description: Always present, unconditionally (Sec.16 row 'quarantine_record (always)', Sec.30, CSCH-EXEC-REQ-041/CSCH-EXEC-REQ-058; NON-BLOCKING-136V-5 for the reason_code-versus-quarantine_reason naming discrepancy). Prevents a quarantine from being recorded without an explanation (Sec.30). A schema-valid code never itself proves the code was correctly assigned for the failure that actually occurred (Layer 4).

state.description: Always present (Sec.30). Record-local QuarantineState (Sec.8.8, 4 values), home schema this file per Sec.8.8's specific per-family table. A schema-valid state value never itself proves the object's actual live quarantine status (Layer 4/5).

authority_disclosure.description: Always present. authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden on this record (Sec.9's 12-file list; 'quarantine becoming authority' is the specific prevention named in Sec.30); is_authoritative remains const false per the shared definition regardless. A valid QuarantineRecord never itself proves an object was physically quarantined, blocked, released, repaired, or made safe (Sec.1, Sec.40).

_extensions.description: Conditionally present: the single reserved Tier 2 extension key (Sec.14). String-valued map only, no nested arbitrary structure. Forward-compatible annotation only; never authority-bearing, never interpreted as quarantine mutation.

object_type.description: Sec.30's 4-value object_type enum. Unknown-value behavior: reject.
